purpose: Evidence sources for the Skills dimension of the five default-off CLI additions (docs/sakullla-workflow/2026-10-03-new-cli-adapters-default-off). The shared Skills pipeline imports packages into each adapter's native discovery directory; these entries record where each directory contract comes from.

zcode.format: Shared resource root ~/.zcode/skills; ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR relocates the whole data root. Delivered with the desktop adapter.

qoder.format: ~/.qoder/skills discovery directory; QODER_CONFIG_DIR relocates the config root.

kimi_code.format: Skills directory under the KIMI_CODE_HOME data root; locally verified 0.31.1 install.

deepseek.format: Ranked .dsh/skills directories; DSH_HOME relocates the data root.

codebuddy.format: Skills directory under the CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR root; npm @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code 2.161.1 verified locally.

acceptanceLimits: Directory contracts verified from official documentation or desktop sources; no live skill execution acceptance performed.
Windows development host only; macOS/Linux not exercised.
Skill package install/update/remove flows through the shared pipeline are covered by the existing synthetic fixtures, not per-CLI live samples.
